title: PatchSet
description: An ordered list of targeted edits across one or more existing resources (panel/dashboard/dataSource/pipeline/pipelineStep/output), produced by conversational refinement so a diff can be previewed and applied atomically. HEL-907 task 1.2: patch-set operations target nodes (the existing `pipelineStep` kind — a PipelineStep IS a node), Outputs (the `output` kind, ADDED by this task), and placements (the existing `panel` kind — an OutputPanel IS a placement) — HEL-904 removed the `dataType`/`metric` target kinds outright (DataType/Metric no longer exist). `output` has no `create` op (mirrors `pipelineStep`'s own precedent): neither `CreateOutputRequest` nor `EditTarget` carries a not-yet-existing Output's parent-pipeline id. A future apply path (HEL-406 and siblings) consumes this artifact.

summary.description: Optional human-readable description of the whole patch set (e.g. an agent's one-line summary of the refinement).

edits.description: Ordered list of targeted edits, applied in array order by a future apply path.

Edit.description: One targeted edit against a single resource. `patch`'s real shape reuses the existing per-resource PATCH/create request shapes rather than inventing new ones, documented here by name (none of the six has its own standalone schema file to $ref against): for op=update, the existing UpdatePanelRequest/UpdateDashboardRequest/UpdateDataSourceRequest/UpdatePipelineRequest/UpdatePipelineStepRequest/UpdateOutputRequest shape matching target.kind (the same type the matching PATCH endpoint already decodes); for op=create, the matching CreatePanelRequest/CreateDashboardRequest/CreateDataSourceRequest/CreatePipelineRequest shape (pipelineStep/output have no create op — see EditTarget's own description), decoded by a future apply path (HEL-406), not this contract; for op=delete, `patch` is unused.

patch.description: Partial update body, real shape selected by (target.kind, op) — see this schema's own description above. Absent for delete edits.

EditTarget.description: Identifies the resource an Edit applies to. `id` is required for update/delete (enforced by Edit's own if/then) and optional for create, where the resource does not yet exist. `output` (HEL-907 task 1.2) has no valid `create` op at all -- CreateOutputRequest carries no parent-pipeline-id field of its own (the real POST /api/pipelines/:id/outputs route takes it from the URL path), and this schema has no field for a not-yet-existing resource's parent id either -- same reason `pipelineStep` has never supported create.
